wty.title: Dealer warranty
wty.text: Repairs after the sale are paid by the dealer. Every warranty sold sets aside a reserve for the claims it is expected to bring; claims are paid from it and what is left is released when the warranty ends.

requirements.title: Warranty administrator contract
requirements.detail: A third party handles claims paperwork and parts pricing.

requirements.title: Consumer warranty terms reviewed by a lawyer
requirements.detail: Terms must meet consumer law: what is covered, what is not, how to claim.

loan.title: Car loans through the bank
loan.text: A bank partner finances your customers. The customer's loan is the bank's, not yours: the bank pays you the car price and a commission on every financed sale. A declined application can lose the sale.

requirements.title: Credit intermediary registration
requirements.detail: Regulator permission to introduce customers to lenders. Reviewed by the regulator.

requirements.title: Bank partner agreement
requirements.detail: Sets the commission schedule and who carries the credit risk (the bank).

requirements.title: Compliance training for sales staff
requirements.detail: Affordability questions and disclosure of the rate.

ins.title: Insurance at the sale
ins.text: Customers can take the first year of motor insurance with the car, cheaper than buying it separately. The insurer pays you a one-time commission on that first-year premium; the customer pays the insurer and holds a real policy.

requirements.title: Insurance intermediary registration
requirements.detail: Registration as a tied agent of the insurer, reviewed by the regulator.

requirements.title: Insurer agency agreement
requirements.detail: Fixes the commission range and the policy wording you may sell.
